question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hermetic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Esoteric**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hermetic"** refers to something that is tightly sealed, isolated, or difficult to understand. It can also mean something esoteric or obscure, understood only by a specific group. (संवेदनशील और गुप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The hermetic seal on the container ensured that no air or moisture could enter.
 
 
 
• **"Esoteric"** refers to knowledge or information that is intended for or understood by only a small group of people with specialized knowledge or interest. (गुप्त, केवल कुछ लोगों के लिए समझने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics was so esoteric that only a few students could follow it.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Hermetic" is synonymous with "Esoteric" because both imply something complex, obscure, or sealed off from general understanding.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Esoteric**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intelligible** (समझने योग्य): Something that can be understood easily.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher explained the concept in an intelligible way so that everyone could understand.
 
 
 
• **Obnoxious** (अरुचिकर): Extremely unpleasant or offensive.
 
 
• **Example:** His obnoxious behavior irritated everyone at the party.
 
 
 
• **Lucid** (स्पष्ट): Clear and easy to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The author's lucid writing style made the complex subject accessible to readers.
